scene harukakirinlobby1
Haruka Hamasaki was a human being living on a planet called “Earth.”
lines.zh: Haruka Hamasaki 是一个人类，住在一颗叫「地球」的星球上。

lines.en: This human being had large breasts and an appetite for self-destruction that, more often than not, resulted in her doing something that she would ultimately regret.
lines.zh: 这个人类有一对巨大的乳房，还有一种自我毁灭的胃口，而那胃口往往会导致她做出一些最终会后悔的事。

lines.en: {size=-3}{i}Tonight would be one more example of that- as being physically ignored by the one person in this city she could always count on to decimate her adulterous vagina didn’t exactly do much for her already debilitated self-esteem.{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}{i}今晚就是又一个例子——被这座城市里唯一一个她总能指望来摧毁她那出轨小穴的人在肉体上无视，对她本就脆弱的自尊可没什么好处。{/i}{/size}

lines.en: And it certainly didn’t help that one of her closest friends was now on a spontaneous anti-teensex tirade (that whore).
lines.zh: 而她最亲密的朋友之一，现在正突然发起一场反对与青少年发生性关系的激烈演说（那个婊子），这也一点忙都帮不上。

lines.en: Haruka Hamasaki was a human being who loved that brand of sex despite only having like one experience with it. And she didn’t like it when people made fun of her hobbies and interests.
lines.zh: Haruka Hamasaki 是一个热爱那一类性爱的人类，尽管她大概只有一次相关经验。而她不喜欢别人嘲笑她的爱好和兴趣。

lines.en: Well, she did actually. Degradation kink. But it’s hard to take pleasure in that sort of thing when it’s only just a recollection and you’re walking through the lobby of a hotel by yourself.
lines.zh: 好吧，其实她喜欢。羞辱癖。可当那只是一段回忆，而你正独自穿过酒店大堂时，很难从这种事里得到快感。

lines.en: And while she could, theoretically, strip down to nothing and attempt to court one of the many plastic snowmen in the room, she would not do this. This ocean of temptation was far too vast.
lines.zh: 虽然理论上，她可以脱个精光，去试着勾引房间里那些塑料雪人中的一个，但她不会这么做。这片诱惑之海太过辽阔。

lines.en: There {i}must{/i} be blood in the water somewhere — a prey ignored by great whites who had already plucked the good bits clean, leaving something for {i}her{/i} to scavenge.
lines.zh: 水里某处{i}一定{/i}有血——某个被大白鲨无视的猎物，它们已经把好的部分啄食干净，留下点什么供{i}她{/i}去捡食。

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby2
Cue Kirin Kanda — resident mola mola, still swimming around with a bite taken out of her like the fish in that one video you might have seen online. You know it, right?
lines.zh: 于是登场的是 Kirin Kanda——本店的翻车鱼，身上被咬掉了一块，还在到处游着，就像你可能在网上看过的那个视频里的鱼。你知道的，对吧？

lines.en: Anyway, that’s what she was. I think they’re also called sunfish. But the important thing is that part of her was ripped off by something (probably not actually a great white) and taken somewhere else.
lines.zh: 总之，她就是那样。我想它们也叫太阳鱼。不过重要的是，她的一部分被什么东西（大概并不是真的大白鲨）撕了下来，带到了别处。

lines.en: But some of her was still here, and that was really all that mattered.
lines.zh: 可她还有一部分在这里，这才是真正重要的。

lines.en: At least until she ultimately succumbs to her wounds and dies or whatever, but that’s a story for another day.
lines.zh: 至少在她最终因伤而死什么的之前是这样，不过那就是另一天的故事了。

lines.en: : That’s it. I give up. What’s even the point?

lines.en: : {i}Kirin, shh. Just let me handle it. I’m friends with her mom and-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}「Kirin，嘘。让我来处理就好。我跟她妈妈是朋友，而且——」{/i}

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby28
: I was never here...and I never saw anything.
lines.zh: : 我从没来过这里……也什么都没看见。

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby29
: What?! Really?! Are you {i}sure{/i} you didn’t see anything?! Not even a little bit?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！真的？！你{i}确定{/i}什么都没看见？！一点点都没有？！

lines.en: : Nope...nothing at all...
lines.zh: : 没有……什么都没有……

lines.en: : Have fun, Kirin...I promise not to tell Sensei either...
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，Kirin……我也保证不会告诉 Sensei……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby30
: {i}{size=-5}Sana! Help! Please!{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-5}Sana！救命！求你了！{/size}{/i}

lines.en: : Hm?...Are you...saying something?...Because I can’t really...hear you...
lines.zh: : 嗯？……你在……说什么吗？……因为我实在……听不见……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby31
: Nope! Anyway, to the vending machines! Come on, Kirin! I’m starting to feel a little {i}thirsty{/i} myself.
lines.zh: : 没有！总之，去自动售货机！走吧，Kirin！我自己也开始有点{i}「渴」{/i}了。

lines.en: : {i}{size=-5}Seriously?...{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-5}不是吧？……{/size}{/i}

lines.en: : Bye, guys...happy Christmalloween...
lines.zh: : 拜拜，两位……圣诞万圣节快乐……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby32
: Oh, Sana. Perfect. Hey, you haven’t seen Kirin wandering around here, have you? She sent me a text just saying “SOS” but refused to elaborate and now she won’t respond at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sana。正好。嘿，你有没有看见 Kirin 在这附近晃悠？她给我发了条短信，只写了「SOS」，却不肯多说，现在干脆完全不回了。

lines.en: : Um...Kirin?...I can’t really remember...Maybe?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Kirin？……我不太记得了……也许吧？……

lines.en: : Who is she...dressed as this year again? All the costumes are...kind of confusing me...
lines.zh: : 她今年又扮成了……谁来着？这些服装都……让我有点糊涂……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby33
: She’s Little Red Riding Hood. But I should probably keep looking if you haven’t seen her and-
lines.zh: : 她扮的是小红帽。不过如果你没看见她，我大概得继续找了，而且——

lines.en: : If she’s...Little Rid Riding Hood...does that make you the...big bad wolf?...
lines.zh: : 如果她是……小红帽……那你不就是……大灰狼？……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby34
: What? No. Okay. I’m a hellhound named Loona from Helluva Boss. You should watch it if you don’t mind subtitles. You’d like it.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。好吧。我扮的是《地狱客栈》里叫 Loona 的地狱犬。你要是不介意字幕，真该看看。你会喜欢的。

lines.en: : Is that a...furry show?...
lines.zh: : 那是……兽人番吗？……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby35
: No! It is {i}not{/i} a furry show. At least...not entirely. But, just so we’re on the same page, there would be nothing {i}wrong{/i} with it if there was.
lines.zh: : 不是！它才{i}不是{/i}兽人番。至少……不完全是。不过咱们先把话说清楚，就算它是，也没什么{i}不对{/i}。

lines.en: : To each their own, Sana. You don’t see us questioning {i}your{/i} fantasies, do you?
lines.zh: : 各有所好嘛，Sana。你也没见我们质疑{i}「你」{/i}的幻想，对吧？

lines.en: : It...probably wouldn’t be worth having them if...nobody ever questioned them at all...
lines.zh: : 如果……从来没有人质疑过它们……那大概也就不值得拥有了……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby36
: Stop...being weird! And I mean that in the most endearing and accepting way possible! Can you just help me look for Kirin, please? I’m worried about her.
lines.zh: : 别……这么奇怪！我这是以最亲切、最包容的方式说的！你能不能帮我找找 Kirin，拜托了？我很担心她。

lines.en: : You are?...How come?...
lines.zh: : 你担心？……为什么？……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby37
: She just wouldn’t send me something like that unless she was in trouble. And it’s not like her to just disappear out of nowhere, so...
lines.zh: : 她要是没遇到麻烦，绝不会给我发那种东西。而且她也不是会莫名其妙就消失的人，所以……

lines.en: : Actually...come to think of it...I think I {i}did{/i} see her...
lines.zh: : 其实……这么一想……我想我{i}「确实」{/i}看见她了……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby38
: You did?! Really?! Where?!
lines.zh: : 你看见了？！真的？！在哪儿？！

lines.en: : I think, um...she was headed toward the convenience store?...You can probably still catch her if you...go now...
lines.zh: : 我想，嗯……她往便利店那边去了？……如果你……现在就去，大概还追得上……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby39
: Ahhh! Thank you so much, Sana! You’re seriously the best!
lines.zh: : 啊！太谢谢你了，Sana！你真是太好了！

lines.en: : Mhm...don’t mention it...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……不客气……

lines.en: scene harukakirinlobby40
: Heh.
